goblin_caves.Name: Goblin Caves
goblin_caves.Description:
Deep beneath the hillside, the Goblin Caves echo with the chattering of greenskins.
Travelers have reported stolen goods and kidnapped villagers. The Goblin King grows bold.
It's time to put an end to their raids.

Encounters.Text:
You enter the dark caves. Two passages split before you.
The left passage has fresh torch marks. The right echoes with dripping water.

You discover a goblin treasure hoard! But it's trapped.
Do you attempt to disarm it or walk away?

haunted_crypt.Name: Haunted Crypt
haunted_crypt.Description:
The ancient crypt of the Mourning Lords has awakened with unholy power.
Undead rise from their tombs, and a dark presence stirs within.
Only the brave dare enter this cursed place.

Encounters.Text:
Skeletal warriors block your path. You notice a crumbling wall to the side.
Fight them head-on or try to sneak past?
You find an altar with a glowing chalice. Do you drink from it?

dragons_lair.Name: Dragon's Lair
dragons_lair.Description:
High in the Scorched Peaks, an ancient red dragon has claimed a mountain as its domain.
Its hoard is legendary, filled with treasures from a thousand conquered kingdoms.
But the dragon Infernus is not easily parted from his gold.

Encounters.Text: A massive lava flow blocks your path. You can try to jump across or find another way.
Dragon cultists guard an inner chamber. They offer to let you pass for tribute.

ancient_ruins.Name: Ancient Ruins
ancient_ruins.Description:
The Lost City of Aethermoor, where an ancient civilization wielded magic beyond comprehension.
Now only stone golems and magical constructs patrol the crumbling halls.
At its heart lies the Arcane Nexus, pulsing with raw power.

Encounters.Text: Ancient runes glow on the walls. You can try to decipher them or move on.
A shimmering portal offers a shortcut, but it radiates unstable energy.

void_temple.Name: Void Temple
void_temple.Description:
Beyond the veil of reality, the Void Temple drifts in eternal darkness.
Here, the Void Lord seeks to consume all of existence.
This is the ultimate challenge - few return from this nightmare realm.

Encounters.Text: Void tendrils reach out to drain your life force. You must act quickly!

Choices.Text: Run through and take the hit

Encounters.Text: An echo of a fallen hero offers you a choice: power or wisdom.
